_comment: Tree of Life Games — add a new entry here to make a new card appear on /games. Slugs map to folders: games/<slug>/index.html. Statuses: 'live' | 'coming-soon' | 'archived' | 'retired' | 'draft'.

games.title: The Garden of Tanya
games.description: Match the chapter illustrations and learn Tanya one pair at a time — every match reveals the chapter’s keyword, capsule summary, and a deeper teaching. Three levels, ages 4 to 120.

games.title: Geulah Protocol
games.description: Eight progressively-themed Torah puzzles — Gematria, the Chain of Chassidus, the Rebbe's Mivtzoim, the Sefiros, and a final Vault. A 45-minute test of learning, memory, and synthesis.

games.title: Geula Quest
games.description: A narrative-driven adventure exploring the path toward Geulah. Walk through scenes, gather wisdom, and complete the journey at your own pace.
